reason: Existing work covers skill redundancy/clone detection, lifecycle governance, unsafe skill evolution, skill-induced failures, router/skill co-evolution, skill compression, and skill-harness optimization, but the supplied primary evidence does not define or solve invariance of an endogenous self-evolving skill control law to semantics-preserving taxonomy split/clone/merge/irreducible partial overlap. Real first-party support-matrix evidence also shows that text dedup, exact-coverage whole-package pruning, and arbitrary context-independent global package reweighting do not remove the residual.

mature_theory_reduction: Fixed-arm contextual-bandit/similarity-aware-experts theory covers information sharing among similar fixed arms, but does not by itself guarantee invariance of an endogenous artifact taxonomy whose identities jointly determine curriculum sampling, fixed-budget retrieval, feedback credit, and incremental refinement.
surviving_boundary: For a self-evolving skill system that treats skill package identities as control units, determine whether semantics-preserving taxonomy transformations that add no semantic support nevertheless change the evolution process solely through representation multiplicity/overlap, after clone dedup, full-coverage package pruning, and arbitrary context-independent global reweighting are exhausted.
strongest_future_same_information_baseli: Decision-time matched control: for upstream curriculum, the strongest generic pre-context controller over the identical library/support fingerprints/quality-exploration statistics and budget, without access to the not-yet-generated task; for post-context retrieval/credit, a context-conditioned simplex/router over the identical task context, support fingerprints, quality/outcome evidence, clone quotienting, capacity, and budget.
required_next_evidence: A faithful real/public dynamic P0 must test end-of-evolution control state, cumulative evolution utility/regret, or downstream task performance under a semantics-preserving taxonomy transformation and the strongest decision-time-matched same-information baseline. The invalid Qwen2.5 rollout provides no scientific evidence.
